name: Mesu ni Natte Ochiru made... -Aoi Natsuki Kairaku Chi○po Ochi-
original_name: 雌に為って堕るまで… -葵なつき 快楽チ○ポ堕ち-
source:
--- I didn't know anything about it.

If I did I wouldn't have been able to laugh about it.
I thought it had nothing to do with me.
I thought that sickness was something happening far away,
and that I would live as a man forever.

The way a woman sees the world.
The way a woman must live.
I was not prepared for any of this, and ended up getting lost in the flow of things.

Wait a minute though... it's not that I regret it.

I (male) ---- no, I (female) am pretty happy with my current self.

--- I never knew, that a woman's body, would feel so good ---

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE248990.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
——我以前什么都不知道。

如果知道，我就无法把它当成笑话。
我以为这与我无关。
我以为那种病只发生在遥远的地方，
我会永远作为男人生活。

女人看世界的方式。
女人必须生活的方式。
我毫无准备，最终迷失在事态洪流中。

不过等等……我并不后悔。

我（男性）——不，我（女性）对现在的自己相当满意。

——我从不知道，女人的身体竟然如此舒服——
